differs.mechanic: A marker climbs one vertical rail in steps, stopping at each milestone so it lights up, instead of a playhead sweeping across three parallel tracks and filling bars.
differs.layout: A tall rail beside a left copy column, years down its left side and milestones stacked to its right, with today at the top, instead of a wide quarter grid under the headline.
differs.data: One ordered path of dated company milestones across years, each with one line, ending in today's figure, instead of three tracks of quarter-dated roadmap work with shipped and planned counts.
differs.moment: The marker reaches the top and today's card unfurls from it with the company's headline figure while every milestone below pulses once, the end of the story rather than a launch mid-year.

blurb: A company's history on a vertical rail: a marker climbs from the founding year, each milestone lights as it passes, and today's card opens at the top.
